events.text: COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Fome strike at midnight in Oyo-petege! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Artificer Directorate of Oyo-petege!
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Litmirvang storm the government palace in Yemavarta! The faction seizes control, establishing the Iron Dominion of Yemavarta.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Ngogha stir mutiny among garrison troops in Tradesh!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Ngogha are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Tradesh!

ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Shubbog the Brood Mother spawns thousands of chittering dark young in the sacred groves of Chektepec, swarming forward under black skies (+20% army power, -6 stability).

ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Victorious armies from Lihapisuyu mandate total political reorganization in Malkhokh! Overthrowing the vanquished elite, they inaugurate the Kingdom of Malkhokh.
Kitlyonwat III of Yiwteltlan comes to the throne bent on glory.
Mourning envelops Yiwteltlan: Kitlyonwat II the Elder Konkech dies of poison. The royal scepter passes to Kitlyonwat, an underage youth of 6 years, under the stewardship of high chancellors.
Chopo of Suhawe takes up the cause of glory.
The death of Tiwi Hugogawo (old age) leaves Suhawe without an acknowledged heir. In the ensuing succession crisis, House Chitu seizes the high throne amidst palace turmoil.
Owa of Lita comes to the throne bent on the fortunes of the dynasty.
Dynastic extinction strikes Lita: Ota dies heirless (a fall from a horse). Amid whispers of poison and sword-drawn councils, House Depapigo claims the vacant crown.
Shuddhaf of Zhevvnazh takes up the cause of the fortunes of the dynasty.
In Zhevvnazh, Teszhifa the Watchful Rurnlay departs this life, succumbing to a hunting accident. The child Shuddhaf (age 2) is crowned beneath a wary council of regents.
Owa of Metono takes up the cause of the safety of the clan-state.
A perilous interregnum grips Metono following the heirless death of Ona (old age). Retainers of House Senobemu storm the assembly and usurp the crown.
Defying the crown of Tirfas, the garrison and civic guilds of Metlapco mutiny! The sovereign Empire of Chekpok is declared with Yeplepchet at its helm.
Yeplepchet is acclaimed ruler of Empire of Chekpok.

Outraged by treason, the crown of Free Trading Cities of Tirfas mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in Empire of Chekpok. The War of the Chekpok Crown begins in fire and iron.
Haruma (Archmage) summons an aura of calm that cleanses local sickness in Luhapampa.
Gufi (Master Artisan) composes an immortal ballad that brings tears to commoners and kings alike in Kifo.
Drotvarvu (Master Artificer) designs a rapid-firing ballista mechanism adopted by frontier garrisons in Vrabad.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Helukenese! Zhentasva seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Grand Duchy of Helukenese!

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Spurred by cries for liberty and bread, popular assemblies across Tessih overthrow the old order! Monarchy is dismantled, and the revolutionary convention inaugurates the Republic of Tessih.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Clandestine agents from Bozedia sow suspicion in the frontier councils of Pawo.

monsters.name: The Eclipse Wolf
monsters.lore: A terrifying dread wolf of midnight taigas, capable of swallowing whole warbands beneath the winter moon.

monsters.name: Glacies the Glacial Drake
monsters.lore: A frost-breathing great wyrm dwelling in glacial crevasses, freezing rivers solid with a single exhalation.

monsters.name: The Emerald Qilin
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: The Great Sun Lion
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: The Frost-Maned Guardian
monsters.lore: A colossal pale tiger of snow-clad ridges, silent as autumn wind, that warbands speak of only in whispers.

monsters.name: Abyssal Terror
monsters.lore: A colossal multi-tentacled sea monster capable of pulling entire armadas down into the black abyss.

monsters.name: The Storm Roc of the Badlands
monsters.lore: The roc of sailors' and caravaneers' tall tales, a bird vast enough to carry off an elephant; its wingbeats raise dust storms over the canyons.

monsters.name: Iron-Hide Boar
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: Bakunawa the Moon-Eater
monsters.lore: A great sea serpent that rises to swallow the moon; villagers drive it back by banging pots and pans until it spits the moon out.

monsters.name: Sasabonsam of the High Branches

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

Res of Yesu comes to the throne bent on the spread of the faith.
Be'uku of E'techi comes to the throne bent on knowledge.
Bapyba of Angiv comes to the throne bent on the safety of the clan-state.
Noga of Bochmu'bul comes to the throne bent on glory.
Vlappymsho of Smov lets go of the aim for a lasting legacy.
Futu of Zishisha comes to the throne bent on the fortunes of the dynasty.
Pisaki conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Serpent Vale) using tactic (score 18 vs DC 8). Defeated Bael. Promoted to F-Rank!
Diluda survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 14 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red. Salvaged ancient relic: Sun Stone Shard!
Wreaths float down the river at Phegorod on midsummer night; young folk of Phegorod leap the fires.
Soldiers scatter the marchers of the Friends of the People in Wapmab; the demand for enfranchisement is drowned in blood.
Delvers of Oyqell break into the bones of an elder wyrm; the deep realm grows.
A warm current sweeps past Plagorod; shoals of silver fish and drifting pearls enrich Plagorod.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Aghtall bars the shaft to Dar Yusa, and the tithe-collectors of Lusipi are turned back at the lamps of Ihlyxyth.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Angiv close the air-lanes above Muzafi, starving Nupamoshu of the high trade.
Zhychice raises its port toll at Zhupa; the harbour-masters of Fypo protest.
The Counting: Scholars and singers of Ayghyth compete in Aziyx; the best verse is carried through the streets.
Feast of Breaking the Fast: Bonfires on the hills of Zishisha greet the high sun above Dar Kazu.
Midsummer Bonfires: Bonfires on the hills of Pafa greet the high sun above Pafa.
Yesu overruns the defensive holdfasts of Qebilalibela, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Tsivyhia.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Charo surrenders to Zhychice; its magistrates swear fealty as Busezitodi's banner is hauled down.
A catastrophic blow to Lenmennesnel Beyond: legions of Pikah overrun the citadel of Chube, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the Hundred Days War of Lenmennesnel Beyond after 3 years. With frontiers redrawn, Pikah dictate terms to the vanquished.
Ilzaghxexa of Oghyth takes up the cause of the safety of the clan-state.
INTERREGNUM ABOLITION: Dynastic collapse in Oghyth ends centuries of kingship! The people formally abolish the monarchy, establishing the Commune of Oghyth.
Sakasha of Lenmennesnel Beyond takes up the cause of the safety of the clan-state.
The death of Litufa Shikizi (old age) leaves Lenmennesnel Beyond without an acknowledged heir. In the ensuing succession crisis, House Zikidikufana seizes the high throne amidst palace turmoil.
E'qexkaqy of Oghyth comes to the throne bent on knowledge.
A perilous interregnum grips Oghyth following the heirless death of Ilzaghxexa (old age). Retainers of House Ehxaxzayq storm the assembly and usurp the crown.
Sagu (Master Artificer) engineers a revolutionary watermill mechanism that doubles grain milling yields in Hawehe.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Lamtel! Bek'oma seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Kingdom of Lamtel!
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Lorüra storm the government palace in Rödokent! The faction seizes control, establishing the Polytechnic League of Rödokent.

STATE ATHEISM PROCLAIMED: The revolutionary leadership in Rödokent enacts Radical Secularization! State religion is abolished, temple estates and monastery vaults are confiscated for the people (+65 gold), and ancient dogma is suppressed.
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Lifudu storm the government palace in Shiyya! The faction seizes control, establishing the Principality of Shiyya.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Ihlyxyth! Ekkagh'a seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Syndicate of Ihlyxyth!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Counterfeit letters planted by Vaviska rupture trust between Nupamoshu and their ally Wezu!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Bilad Susa divert 25 gold from the tax vaults of Wezu!
QUEST COMPLETED: Recovery of the Scattered Herds at Sommdef! Gokhüla returns with the full herd and the clans reward the rider with 100 Gold!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Wezu pave the Komov-Hashov Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Komov and Hashov (+trade, +stability).
RUINOUS GIFT: Luxuria the Gilded Prince intoxicates the high courts of Busezitodi with exquisite hedonism! Opulence surges alongside reckless decadence (+40 gold, -10 stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Undina of the Silver Basin purifies the sacred rivers of Ngiviq! Abundant fish and unhindered river trade enrich the townships (+30 gold, +12 stability).

Galled by heavy biomass tribute and distant decrees, the citizens of Tijaviq cast out their clan wardens! Renouncing all allegiance to Vulaqiniq, Ngara proclaims the sovereign Polytechnic League of Tijaviq.
Ngara is acclaimed ruler of Polytechnic League of Tijaviq.

Outraged by treason, the crown of Free Trading Cities of Vulaqiniq mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in Polytechnic League of Tijaviq. The Border War of Tijaviq begins in fire and iron.

monsters.name: The Thousand-Tentacled Horror
monsters.lore: A colossal multi-tentacled sea monster capable of pulling entire armadas down into the black abyss.

monsters.name: Behemoth the Earth-Shaker
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: Snow-Ghost of the High Passes
monsters.lore: A colossal pale tiger of snow-clad ridges, silent as autumn wind, that warbands speak of only in whispers.

monsters.name: The Celestial Raptor
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: The Rime-Bane
monsters.lore: A frost-breathing great wyrm dwelling in glacial crevasses, freezing rivers solid with a single exhalation.

monsters.name: Shadow of the Loch
monsters.lore: An elusive plesiosaur-like lake cryptid spoken of in local campfire folklore, surfacing only when mists veil the waters.

monsters.name: Fenrir Shadow-Stalker
monsters.lore: A terrifying dread wolf of midnight taigas, capable of swallowing whole warbands beneath the winter moon.

monsters.name: The Emerald Qilin
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: The Three-Headed Zmey
monsters.lore: A many-headed dragon of the steppe-forests that grows heads back as fast as heroes cut them.

monsters.name: The Qalupalik of the Ice Edge
monsters.lore: A sea creature with long nails that steals children who wander too close to the ice.

monsters.name: The Each-uisge of the Loch
monsters.lore: A water horse that lets riders mount, then plunges into the loch with them stuck fast.

monsters.name: Kappa of the Reed Pools
monsters.lore: A water imp with a dish of water on its head; bow to it, and courtesy forces it to bow back and spill its strength.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

events.text: Defying the crown of Fudadida, the garrison and civic guilds of Qasar mutiny! The sovereign Grand Duchy of Qasar is declared with Wufyaqqa at its helm.
Wufyaqqa is acclaimed ruler of Grand Duchy of Qasar.
Vowing to eradicate rebellion, Commune of Fudadida marches swiftly upon Grand Duchy of Qasar. The drums of the Qasar Campaign echo across the provinces.
Rala (Philosopher) drafts a universal legal code that enhances provincial stability in Ka-lebe.
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Ehzayxe'y strike at midnight in Azhugg! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Grand Duchy of Azhugg!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Bisqas divert 18 gold from the tax vaults of Yvotri!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Cholitlan pave the Chotlo-Hawetlhuacan Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Chotlo and Hawetlhuacan (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Al-qur pave the Al-qur-Laabad Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Al-qur and Laabad (+trade, +stability).

The Great Modoni War is known as the Unification among the Bunru, and as the Subjugation among the Druyvedvi.
A victor's peace is forged: after 2 years of campaign in the So'mosa Succession War, Ra-firi prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
A catastrophic blow to Buse: legions of Peloso overrun the citadel of Batadi, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
TITAN REAWAKENING: After centuries of primordial slumber, the immortal Brimstone the Dragon-King (Ancient Red Dragon) awakens in Wilds beyond Bemöchu! Its primeval fury shakes the continent.
Feast of the First Foal: People of Bemyurt wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Drolri.
Griots’ Epic Nights: Scholars and singers of Fesufe compete in Rokuso; the best verse is carried through the streets.
An ancient sovereign power falls to dust: Popular Commonwealth of Buse is extinguished. Royal archives smolder, and Yape Pabu flees into obscurity.
Night of Lanterns: Scholars and singers of Rutsaf compete in Laabad; the best verse is carried through the streets.
The War of the Peloso Crown reaches its conclusion after less than a year of bloodshed: Peloso & Nosogu triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
First Fruit Offerings: Granaries of Ra-firi are opened at Wenetunge; the whole town eats until dusk.
Envoys from Ceniqukuna and Mimurengi exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
Fikupu of Modoni takes up the cause of a lasting legacy.
In Modoni, Nuti the Sly Rowiki departs this life, succumbing to fever. The child Fikupu (age 10) is crowned beneath a wary council of regents.
The black rot strikes the frontier! Church bells toll without ceasing as pestilence stalks streets and houses.
A rust-blight sweeps the gene-farms of Za'elhloth; biomass runs short.
In the hungry year Ye'oqtioz spends the treasury of Za'elhloth on grain from abroad; few starve, and they remember who fed them.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Modoni! Shirsqat seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Principality of Modoni!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Yrigarh divert 25 gold from the tax vaults of Azhloth!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Lyarhear divert 23 gold from the tax vaults of Uqxyth!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Lyarhear are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Uqxyth!
QUEST COMPLETED: Delve into the Primeval Foundry in Pororipo! Shranva returns triumphant from Pororipo, having uncovered forgotten secrets and winning Immortal Renown!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Mu'taku embarks upon the Search for the Buried Stela of Sewo! Mu'taku hears that a founding stela was buried by jungle growth near Sewo.
TITAN CLASH: The armies of Bapo clash with Brimstone the Dragon-King in cell 6937! The beast resists with 300/340 HP.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Gho'ozqyyt pave the Gho'ozqyyt-Ta'pu Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Gho'ozqyyt and Ta'pu (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Yehetono pave the Ix-ta'bew-Yehepome Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Ix-ta'bew and Yehepome (+trade, +stability).
PATRON MIRACLE: Solarius the Dawn-Bringer bestows a radiant dawn upon Etuygh! Granaries overflow with miraculous golden grain, soothing civil unrest (+18 stability, +20 gold).
ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Cthulor the Abyssal Slumberer stirs in the ocean abyss beneath Fesufe! Barnacle-encrusted cyclopean monoliths surface, loaded with pre-human treasure (+35 gold, -5 stability).
Rogue splicer Ixzahxa cures a blight in Uter that the clans of Uter engineered; the poor make them a saint.
Unrest of the year: tax riots in Laabad (Rutsaf).

Shirsqat of Modoni comes to the throne bent on glory.
Rose conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Radiant Mirage) using assault (score 32 vs DC 8). Defeated Thalor. Promoted to F-Rank!
Tloha survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 12 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red.
Etuygh completes a non-Euclidean spire at Etuygh, a marvel of the Eyrerxit' people.
Soldiers scatter the marchers of the Franchise Leaguers in Hobaha; the demand for enfranchisement is drowned in blood.
Sule unveils a self-seeding wheat; biomass vats overflow from Sule to the frontier.
A cold upwelling chills the domes of Qasar; kelp farms wither and the reefs bleach.
SEA EMBARGO: Kibiyya seals the deep channels, and no hull leaves the port of Rebọ for Nigife.
Garrison at Tibajing repels a cross-planet invasion pouring through the Shattered Door!
Garrison at U'tikab repels a cross-planet invasion pouring through the Shattered Veil!
Chu'lajaw marches an army across the Shattered Veil into Modu, storming Oghyax!

monsters.lore: A colossal pale tiger of snow-clad ridges, silent as autumn wind, that warbands speak of only in whispers.

monsters.name: The Rime-Bane

monsters.name: Titan of the Steppes

monsters.name: Brimstone the Dragon-King

monsters.name: Tepegöz the One-Eyed
monsters.lore: A one-eyed giant of the steppe epics, slain only by a hero clever enough to blind him.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.
